text:
Alex Chang: Quick async check — final owners and blockers for v2 TextGen endpoint deprecation this sprint? Need to lock canary dates and SDK bump plan. @Maria @Samir PTAL. Link to plan: https://go/redwood/v2-deprec-plan (permissions: eng+pm)

Maria Gomez: I can own the SDK releases (Node & Python). Need docs sign-off on examples and runtime confirmation for endpoint aliasing during overlap. @Linh can you confirm routing fallback behavior?

Samir Patel: I'll own rollout and monitoring hooks. Open PRs to watch: runtime#432, infra#211. Infra needs a migration window for proxy config change — otherwise older SDKs may break. Potential blocker: rate-limit header change unless we add compat header `x-rw-compat:1`.

Linh Ngo: Routing fallback exists but streaming behavior differs. Need a small shim for streaming tokens. Plan: add feature flag `compat.v2_streaming_shim`. Rough ETA 2 days for code + unit tests.

Pranay Rao: Docs/comms: I'll draft deprecation notices and blog. Also recommend we add an eval harness in Redwood Optimize to detect quality regressions after SDK bump — pinging ML for dataset.

deploy-bot: deploy status — infra#211 queued for canary deploy, ETA ~2h. CI snapshot: python-sdk tests 118/120 passing (2 flakey timeouts).

Alex Chang: Owners so far: SDK -> Maria; Rollout/monitoring -> Samir; Runtime shim -> Linh; Docs/comms -> Pranay. Please drop links to the PR/doc you'll update by EOD and add yourself to the ownership matrix: https://go/redwood/ownership-matrix

Maria Gomez: Node SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-node/pull/789. Python SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/654. Will add release notes + compatibility tests that inject header when server returns 410 or `x-rw-deprecate` header. Example test curl: `curl -H "Accept: application/json" -H "x-rw-deprecate: 1" https://api.redwood.com/v2/textgen`

Samir Patel: Monitoring hooks PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/456. I'll add smoke checks and a canary dashboard for token-latency regressions.

Linh Ngo: Runtime shim draft: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1012. Config example: `compat.v2_streaming_shim = true` and `compat.header = "x-rw-compat"`. Integration tests blocked on infra slot.

Pranay Rao: Deprecation draft: https://docs.redwood.com/announcements/v2-deprec-draft (wip). Scheduling: propose canary window 2025-06-03 10:00 UTC. I'll ping infra/ops to reserve.

Alex Chang: Two asks: 1) If you expect customer-impacting behavior, mark P1 here. 2) SDK owners — add a short note about how older SDKs will surface compatibility info and fallback behavior.

Maria Gomez: Will mark P1 if proxy change lands before shim. Adding SDK note to PRs now describing header injection and automatic fallback for newer SDKs.

Samir Patel: Not P1 yet. Will escalate if infra changes land without shim.

Linh Ngo: ETA for shim code + unit tests: tomorrow noon UTC. Need infra canary slot for integration run — @Pranay can you confirm?

Pranay Rao: Confirming canary slot for 2025-06-03 10:00 UTC. Pinged infra and ops. Can owners confirm by EOD?

Maria Gomez: Yes — will finish PR/tests by EOD.

Samir Patel: Yes — will add canary smoke checks and runbook.

Linh Ngo: Yes — will open integration run and toggle flag during canary.

Pranay Rao: Yes — coordinating comms and infra.

Alex Chang: Closing loop — thanks everyone :thumbsup: If anything changes, update the ownership row and drop a short note here.
